correctness.rationale: First LU row pivot reads only first column of transposed sketch; ratio of two iid standard normals is Cauchy. Norm-pivot choice uses independent chi-square lengths and a Beta(s/2,s/2) ratio. Cross approximation on a diagonal 2x2 matrix has exactly error 1 or kappa. Beta-density endpoint analysis gives the exact constant 2Gamma(s)/(sGamma(s/2)^2), all real moment orders and boundaries. Reconstructed manually and verified with standalone independent polynomial identities.

broader_coverage.reasoning: High-probability CUR quality or worst-case ARP analyses alone do not determine these moments or prove failure of first-pivot LU to exploit all s sketch coordinates. The full preconditioner guarantee concerns a different, adaptive output. This is not a claim that all sparse-sign or multilevel algorithms fail.

value.rationale: A parameter-free and sharp separation explains why increasing Gaussian sketch oversampling does not improve the moment safety of the first row-partial-LU pivot, despite selection being correct with probability tending to one. It quantifies rare catastrophic relative rank-one errors, while a standard CPQR alternative exploits all sketch rows and shifts the exact cutoff from 1 to s, offering a concrete algorithm-design criterion rather than only an incidental finite example.
